name: Desert Oasis Camp
author: voodoo573
description: A palm-ringed oasis pool in open desert, with four colourful travellers' tents at the corners, a campfire, supply crates and scattered rocks. Good for caravan stops and ambushes. 24 x 18 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Desert oasis with palms, pool, tents and a campfire.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
